description: Is It Legit is the consumer brand-trust tool from M8ven. Given a brand name or URL, it analyzes 100+ trust signals and returns a verdict (safe / caution / avoid) with key findings. Designed for "is this site real?" / "should I buy from this brand?" / "is this an Instagram-ad scam?" type questions.
